title: Phase Plate Contrast Enhancement in Cryo-Electron Tomography
content: The Volta phase plate (VPP) has proven to be a valuable tool in cryo-electron microscopy (cryoEM), particularly for solving small protein structures where phase contrast is critical for visualization [1,2]. In cryo-electron tomography (cryoET), the use of the VPP has been reported to improve the visualization of macromolecular structures in complex cellular environments [3]. However, despite these qualitative observations, a systematic and quantitative comparison of the effect of the VPP on tomographic contrast and alignment remains lacking.
